summary: Wife of Angelo Petriello at Guardia Lombardi; John's maternal 4th-great-grandmother.
bio:
Lucia Marra was the wife of Angelo Petriello of Guardia Lombardi and is John's maternal 4th-great-grandmother. She had died by March 1901.

The Marra and Petriello families of Guardia intermarried more than once: another couple there, Carmine Petriello and Maria Marra, were the parents of Giuseppe Petriello, who married Concetta di Marino in 1855, though how Maria was related to Lucia is not known. The Petriello, Marra, Di Marino and De Biasi families regularly stood as witnesses for one another in the town's records.
